headline: DTE Energy (DTE) Stock Looks Fully Priced As Its 45% Run Matures
summary: DTE Energy stock has delivered a 45.2% return over the past three years, yet current valuation checks and an intrinsic value estimate from a Dividend Discount Model (DDM) suggest it now trades close to what those models see as fair rather than as a clear bargain. With the share price recently at US$141.72 and short term returns softer, the question is whether the current level still offers an attractive entry point for new capital.
